changes.en: About half the amount thickens as much liquid. The sauce turns glossy rather than matt, and the book says a sauce thickened with cornstarch should not be reheated.
changes.de: Etwa die halbe Menge dickt gleich viel Flüssigkeit an. Die Sauce wird glänzend statt matt; laut Buch soll eine mit Speisestärke gedickte Sauce nicht wieder erhitzt werden.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Cornstarch
sources.sentence: One unit of cornstarch thickens about twice as much liquid as an equal unit of flour.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Starches
sources.sentence: Cornstarch, arrowroot, and potato starch are almost pure starches and produce shiny sauces, whereas flour contains protein, which gives flour-thickened sauces a slightly mat appearance.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Cornstarch
sources.sentence: Products thickened with cornstarch should not be reheated.
